messages:
Anika Rao: Heads-up: hourly telemetry for `signup_flow.completed` shows a 3-hour gap 2026-04-10 01:00-04:00 UTC. Dashboards show zeros for tenant group B. Alerting flagged it.
Ben Lowe: Seen it. Looks like consumer lag + a normalization change. I'd prefer a staged approach: preview -> canary promote -> full targeted recompute.
Carlos Vega: Agreed. UX ask for console: preview modal should show routing tier, est compute units (CU), estimated queue wait for each quota_profile, and a tiny sample diff. That avoids blind promotes.
Zoe Park: From infra side: add a routing policy rule for promoted jobs from previews: default to `background` unless preview checksum delta <0.05% then allow `fair-share`. Also require `invalidate_on_promote` checkbox for metrics with KV cache.
Anika Rao: Plan: run a 1-hour preview on a subset of shards (s[410,411]) with emit_samples=20 and emit_invalidation_preview=true. If preview delta < 0.1% and diffs are normalization-only, schedule canary for 10% shards.
replay-bot: Job queued: preview-1759990123-410 (status: queued)
Ben Lowe: I'll kick the preview via internal API. Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/reprocess \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"range":"2026-04-10T01:00:00Z/2026-04-10T02:00:00Z","shards":[410,411],"preview":true,"emit_samples":20,"emit_invalidation_preview":true,"quota_profile":"background"}'
```
replay-bot: Job started: preview-1759990123-410 (status: running)
Carlos Vega: Small policy note: UI should surface a suggested `quota_profile` based on estimated CU and current fair-share depth so reviewers can pick with data.
Zoe Park: Also: require auto-cancel of any promote if preview returns schema mismatch or checksum delta >0.5%. For 0.1%-0.5% require manual approval and a short pre-promote smoke.
replay-bot: Job finished: preview-1759990123-410 (status: success)
Ben Lowe: Preview results: checksum delta 0.07%. Sample diffs: 6 rows (timestamp normalization + one renamed field). Invalidation preview keys: inv:signup_flow.completed:shard:410:20260410T01. Est CU: 120, est wait (background): ~9m.
Anika Rao: 0.07% in the manual-approval window. Next step: schedule canary (10% shards) with `quota=background`, `cost_cap=500`, `invalidate_on_promote=true`, and `post_promote_smoke=true`. We'll require manual sign-off before the full run.
Carlos Vega: For the console: add a small approval flow that records who approved and shows the preview checksum + sample diffs inline. Keep it minimal.
Zoe Park: I'll update routing rules: canary runs use `background` by default but can be escalated to `fair-share` after successful smoke. Also implement a short preempt policy so large promotes don't block reserved pools.
Ben Lowe: Kicking canary in ~15m. Will paste the promote curl and job id here.
replay-bot: Canary queued: canary-1759990450-10pct (status: queued)
Anika Rao: Thanks. When canary completes, post the smoke results here. If delta spikes >0.5% abort and escalate to data-platform.
